text: OK, so the USA didn't know that the Israelis were gunna blow up South Pars gas field. So what. It like a couple of bank robbers, and one of them shoots a bystander. The other robber says he is innocent while in commission of a crime. They are jointly charged with murder, and both are found guilty. Standard criminal law principle. They are equally guilty they jointly started this war. What one does, the other is also aiding them. Is Operation Clusterf**k going to succeed is Israel and the US going to put sufficient boots on the ground.? For 20 years in a place that is a bit larger than Afghanistan with decentralised command structures. In terrain not suitable for mechanised warfare.... it is mountainous.... not a flat place. The price of oil is going up is the President of the USA going to continue with tariffs so that the citizens of the US can get the opportunity to pay more? (The US Govt pockets the tariffs at it's citizens expense) Luckily the military cost to the USA is only US$10 to 16 Billion so far. A bargain. 2 or 3 weeks of conflict, and that is the price.
